glossary: PE / put option
A bet that Nifty will fall. Buying one pays if it falls; selling one pays you upfront and costs you if it falls.
CE / call option
A bet that Nifty will rise.
Lot
Nifty options trade in lots of 65 units. ₹1 of option price = ₹65 per lot.
Put spread
Sell one put, buy a cheaper one below it. You collect money, and your loss is capped.
15-min candle close
Wait for the 15-minute bar on the chart to finish before acting, so one spike doesn't fool you.
Call spread
Sell one call, buy a cheaper one above it. You collect money, and your loss is capped.
Iron condor
A call spread and a put spread sold together. You collect both premiums; it pays if Nifty stays between the two sold strikes, and the loss is capped.

trade.name: Makes money if Bank Nifty stays below 62,200 till Monday 23 Nov
legs: SELL 1 lot  Bank Nifty 23-Nov  62,200 CE  at about ₹345
BUY  1 lot  Bank Nifty 23-Nov  62,400 CE  at about ₹272
trade.maxLoss: The most you can lose: ₹3,810 (127 points × 30)
trade.when: These are 1:15 pm prices; they will move. If you sold the 12:15 spread (62,300/62,500) for about ₹90, keep it, it is now worth ₹67. Otherwise enter only after a bounce to 62,000–62,150 stalls for 15 minutes.
trade.exit: Close both legs if a 15-minute candle closes above 62,400, or once you have kept half of the ₹2,190.

why: Today's biggest bet, 38,000 contracts, says Bank Nifty stays under 62,000, and 17,500 of them were added today; that is why a rise to 62,000–62,150 is where you sell.
Since 12:45 big traders pulled 13,000 bets that it won't fall while adding 9,600 bets that it won't rise, so the floor near the price keeps weakening.
Big traders still hold 39,000 bets that it won't fall below 61,000 and 41,000 at 60,000, so a drop usually slows there.
Option prices point to a move of about 440 points either way today, so a bounce to 62,000 is within reach; sell there, not at the low.
simple.risk: Trade one lot only. ₹3,810 is the most you can lose, more than the ₹2,190 you collect, so honour the 62,400 stop. Bank Nifty moves 400 points in minutes. Paper-trade two weeks before real money.
glossary: PE / put option
A bet that Nifty will fall. Buying one pays if it falls; selling one pays you upfront and costs you if it falls.
CE / call option
A bet that Nifty will rise.
Lot
Bank Nifty options trade in lots of 30 units. ₹1 of option price = ₹30 per lot.
Put spread
Sell one put, buy a cheaper one below it. You collect money, and your loss is capped.
15-min candle close
Wait for the 15-minute bar on the chart to finish before acting, so one spike doesn't fool you.
Call spread
Sell one call, buy a cheaper one above it. You collect money, and your loss is capped.
